QuestInfo.name: [Lachelein] Break the Plates (2)
QuestInfo.0: The music box sound is coming from Pie Mask. You should talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: The music box sound is coming from Pie Mask. \r\nGet 20 #t4034982# and talk to Pie Mask.
QuestInfo.2: Pie Mask turned into a music box. The Dreamkeepers disappeared when you destroyed it, but Protective Mask was not pleased.

0.msg: This is the city of dreams and illusions! We eat, drink, and dance! That is why all of us are happy! We don't have any worries, ha ha! Life is perfect here.

1.msg: #b(Are you really happy with such a shallow existence?)

2.msg: This is the city of dreams and illusions! Ha ha ha!

5.msg: I'm absolutely happy! You two are disturbing my happiness! Don't make me call the Dreamkeepers!

8.msg: We will help you, whatever your troubles may be.

9.msg: I...  I've won this eating contest 65,535 times. Winning is meaningless now. No one congratulates me.

11.msg: You're not taking this seriously! Let's start the contest over. If I break all the plates, these fools will just forget.

0.msg: Bring me 20 Green Victory Plates as proof! The Victory Plates are on Victory Plate Street 2!

no.0: I'm thinking of calling the Dreamkeepers!

0.msg: And the winner is... Pie Mask!

1.msg: They held the eating contest while you were gone.

2.msg: Wow! Did you SEE how much food that was?

3.msg: I lost? How? I was so SURE I was going to win this time!

4.msg: I still don't understand how me breaking all the plates would have helped him win his first victory.

5.msg: It's not like you broke ALL the plates anyway.

yes.0: I did it... Everybody, look at me! I won! I'm so happy... Aren't I?

default.0: 20 Green Victory Plates will be enough!
